title_zh: 约定修订虚构政权展板的抗议表述

scenario.label_zh: 区分虚构政权材料中的批评与反抗
scenario.goal_zh: 根据材料区分公开谴责与违抗禁令，并约定在展板中分别说明

context_zh: 两名学生依据虚构历史案例中的报纸与剧院记录制作课堂展板。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: Our caption says the newspaper tried to overthrow the dictator. Is that in the case file?

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.text: No. The editorial does denounce his censorship, but it does not call for his removal.

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: What about the actors? The file says they performed the banned play.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.text: That means they chose to defy the ban. It does not prove they shared every view in the editorial.

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: Then we need two separate descriptions: public criticism in the newspaper, and a prohibited performance at the theatre.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.text: Exactly. I will replace the overthrow claim with those two descriptions and cite each record separately.
